                    myDocsActionsMenuPopulator(renderCtx, calloutActionMenu);
                else
                    CalloutOnPostRenderTemplate(renderCtx, calloutActionMenu);

                                callout.close();

                        }
                    }));
                }
            };

            var registerOverride = function(id) {
                var followingOverridePostRenderCtx = {};
                followingOverridePostRenderCtx.BaseViewID = 'Callout';
                followingOverridePostRenderCtx.ListTemplateType = id;

<div id="ctl00_ctl45_g_2c715b28_69d2_46ea_ac3b_ed9d547533f3_BGVideoOverlay"><div class="container-1080"><div class="center-align-container col-50 blue-background transparent white-text text-center"><h1 class="s-spacing introHeading">Experience<br/></h1><h2 class="xs-spacing pageSubTitle introSubHeading">the Daktronics Difference</h2><p class="shadow white-text">From your local high school scoreboard to video systems in major league stadiums, and roadside LED signs to iconic digital signage in Times Square, Piccadilly Circus and around the world, there's a good chance you see our products every day.</p><p><a class="btn btnWhite btnInvert s-spacing text-center homepageProjectGalleryButton" href="/en-us/photos"><i class="fas fa-camera" style="margin-right: 15px;"></i>View Our Project Gallery</a></p><br/><br/></div></div></div>

<div class="gray-background"><div class="container-1080"><div class="col-66 center-align-container text-center l-spacing"><h2>
<a href="/en-us/markets">How can the industry's most experienced digital display manufacturer help you?</a></h2></div><div class="switcher animate"><div class="switcherControls text-center m-spacing">
<a class="btn btn2ndColor btnMedium btnInvert selected" data-for="sports">Sports</a><a class="btn btn2ndColor btnMedium btnInvert" data-for="ooh">Out of Home Advertising</a><a class="btn btn2ndColor btnMedium btnInvert" data-for="business">Business &amp; Community</a><a class="btn btn2ndColor btnMedium btnInvert" data-for="transportation">Transportation</a> </div><div class="switcherContent m-spacing" style="height: 238px;"><div class="sports"><div class="col-66 center-align-container text-center"><h2 class="pageSubTitle">Ultimate Game-Day Experience</h2><p>Go to the most trusted partner to make your game day memorable for everyone. Enhance fan experiences thanks to our unmatched services team while creating revenue from eye-catching graphics and sponsor ads on a system that is guaranteed to last.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor" href="/en-us/markets/sports" style="margin-right:5px;">View Sports Products and Services</a><a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor homepageProjectGalleryButton" href="/en-us/markets/sports/projects"><i class="fas fa-camera" style="margin-right:15px;"></i>See the Sports Project Gallery</a></p></div></div><div class="ooh hide"><div class="col-66 center-align-container text-center"><h2 class="pageSubTitle">Unmatched Service, Every Step Of The Way</h2><p class="text-center">While TV, mobile and online have seen increases in blocked or skipped ads, Out of Home market remains the only advertising medium that cannot be overlooked. It is seen by real people where other mediums simply cannot go to engage consumers.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor" href="/en-us/markets/out-of-home-advertising" style="margin-right:5px;">View OOH Products and Services</a><a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor homepageProjectGalleryButton" href="/en-us/markets/out-of-home-advertising/projects"><i class="fas fa-camera" style="margin-right:15px;"></i>See the OOH Project Gallery</a></p></div></div><div class="business hide"><div class="center-align-container col-66 text-center"><h2 class="pageSubTitle">Target Key Audiences with LED Signs</h2><p>LED signs are one of the most cost-effective advertising options available. Invest in the ability to share the right message at the right time to the right audience—and get results.<br/><br/></p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor" href="/en-us/markets/commercial" style="margin-right:5px;">View Products and Services</a><a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor homepageProjectGalleryButton" href="/en-us/markets/commercial/projects"><i class="fas fa-camera" style="margin-right:15px;"></i>See the Business &amp; Community Project Gallery</a></p></div></div><div class="transportation hide"><div class="col-66 center-align-container text-center"><h2 class="pageSubTitle">Guide &amp; Inform Travelers on Their Journey</h2><p>No other manufacturer can provide a truly integrated system from a single supplier. Our products are designed and manufactured to connect you with your drivers and passengers.<br/><br/></p><p class="text-center">
<a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor" href="/en-us/markets/transportation" style="margin-right:5px;">View Products and Services</a><a class="btn btnMedium btn3rdColor homepageProjectGalleryButton" href="/en-us/markets/transportation/projects"><i class="fas fa-camera" style="margin-right:15px;"></i>See the Transportation Project Gallery</a></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></span>
<div class="bgImage feature" style="padding-bottom:200px;">
<br/>
<div class="section l-spacing"><div class="col span_1_of_2 darkGray-background transparent"><div class="section"><div class="col span_1_of_6">
<br/>
</div><div class="col span_5_of_6 white-text"><h3 class="white-text">Featured Installation<br/></h3><h2 class="xs-spacing">
<a href="/en-us/markets/sports/major-league-sports-installation/mercedes-benz-stadium">Mercedes-Benz Stadium</a></h2><p class="m-spacing">Mercedes-Benz Stadium continues our streak of having equipment used at football's biggest game for the last 15 straight years.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnWhite btnInvert btnMedium" href="/en-us/markets/sports/major-league-sports-installation/mercedes-benz-stadium">Learn more about our involvement at Mercedes-Benz Stadium</a></p>
<br/>
</div></div></div></div>

<br/>
<br/>
</div><div class="center-align-container col-75" style="padding-top:0px;margin-top:-150px;"><div class="section background"><div class="col span_1_of_4 xs-spacing">
<a href="/news/Pages/Texas-Rangers-Taking-Total-Control-With-Daktronics-Show-Control-System.aspx"><img alt="Texas Rangers Installation Photo" src="/SiteCollectionImages/Homepage/News/Texas-Rangers_Globe-Life-Park.jpg?RenditionID=46" style="max-width:100%;"/></a>
<h4>
<a href="/news/Pages/Texas-Rangers-Taking-Total-Control-With-Daktronics-Show-Control-System.aspx">Texas Rangers Taking Total Control with Show Control System</a></h4><p>Texas Rangers added Show Control System featuring new Live Clips and Camino technology as a complete audiovisual control solution throughout the ballpark.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btnGray btnInvert" href="/news/Pages/Texas-Rangers-Taking-Total-Control-With-Daktronics-Show-Control-System.aspx">Read More</a></p></div><div class="col span_1_of_4 xs-spacing">
<a href="/news/Pages/Daktronics-and-AdverDia-Group-Bring-Messages-To-Major-Roadway-In-Bahamas.aspx"><img alt="Fusion Superplex Installation Photo" src="/SiteCollectionImages/Homepage/News/Fusion-Superplex-Cinema_Nassau-Bahamas.jpg?RenditionID=46" style="max-width:100%;"/></a>
<h4>
<a href="/news/Pages/Daktronics-and-AdverDia-Group-Bring-Messages-To-Major-Roadway-In-Bahamas.aspx">AdverDia Group Bring Messages To Major Roadway In Bahamas</a></h4><p>Fusion Superplex installed a new digital LED display on the façade of their new facility in Nassau, Bahamas to announce current and upcoming movies and events.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btnGray btnInvert" href="/news/Pages/Daktronics-and-AdverDia-Group-Bring-Messages-To-Major-Roadway-In-Bahamas.aspx">Read More</a></p></div><div class="col span_1_of_4 xs-spacing">
<a href="/en-us/products/video-displays/video-wall">
<img alt="Arcteryx Installation Photo" src="/SiteCollectionImages/Homepage/News/Video-Walls.jpg?RenditionID=46" style="max-width:100%;"/> </a>
<h4>
<a href="/en-us/products/video-displays/video-wall">Bring Impactful Imagery into Your Space with Video Walls</a></h4><p>This engaging and informative digital platform provides dynamic content opportunities for advertisers, sponsors and self-promotion.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btnGray btnInvert" href="/en-us/products/video-displays/video-wall">Read More</a></p></div><div class="col span_1_of_4 xs-spacing">
<a href="/news/Pages/Video-Ribbon-Displays-Light-up-Richmond-International-Airports-Ticket-Counters.aspx">
<img alt="" src="/SiteCollectionImages/Homepage/News/Richmond-Intl-Ticket-Counters.jpg?RenditionID=46" style="max-width:100%;"/></a>
<h4>
<a href="/news/Pages/Video-Ribbon-Displays-Light-up-Richmond-International-Airports-Ticket-Counters.aspx">Video Ribbon Displays Light up Richmond International Airport's Ticket Counters</a></h4><p>Two 4-millimeter LED ribbon displays each measuring 150 feet long guide travelers through the ticket area.</p><p>
<a class="btn btnMedium btnGray btnInvert" href="/news/Pages/Video-Ribbon-Displays-Light-up-Richmond-International-Airports-Ticket-Counters.aspx">Read More</a></p></div></div></div><div class="container-1080"><div class="section"><div class="col span_1_of_5">
<span class="fa-stack fa-3x">
<i class="fas fa-circle text-gradient fa-4x"></i>
<i class="fas fa-box fa-inverse fa-1x" style="left:62%;top:15%;"></i>
<i class="fas fa-headset fa-inverse fa-1x" style="left:25%;top:50%;"></i>
<i class="fas fa-wrench fa-inverse fa-1x" style="left:100%;top:50%;"></i></span> </div><div class="col span_4_of_5"><h2>
<a href="/en-us/support">Committed to the highest level of customer service.</a></h2><p>Service and parts, when you need it and how you need it. Our trained technicians, located around the world, provide service to meet your standards of excellence.<br/></p><p>
<a class="btn btn2ndColor btnMedium btnInvert" href="/en-us/support">View Support Resources</a></p></div></div></div><div class="bgImage reliability"><div class="center-align-container col-75"><div class="section"><div class="col span_1_of_2 white-text"><h2 class="white-text">Products designed to withstand even the harshest conditions.</h2>
